meaning.interaction: Each operation is a real Playwright locator.click with trusted browser input. Capture listeners start timing at click delivery, then wait for two requestAnimationFrame callbacks in the component iframe. Each following click starts only after the previous sample and state check return.
meaning.timing: eventToSecondRafMs and captureToSecondRafMs end at the second rAF callback, before state inspection. This is a paint opportunity, not proof of physical paint and not INP. Event timestamps do not include all pointerdown-to-click input latency.
meaning.transport: nodeOperationMs and phase wall times include Playwright actionability/scroll/transport waits and state checks. CDP TaskDuration is renderer main-thread task duration, not elapsed transport waiting or a direct OS CPU-utilization measurement; it includes the audit work executed on that renderer during its measurement boundary.
meaning.workload: One mounted component per fresh Chrome, 30 warmup cycles then 100 measured cycles by default, alternating select page and clear selection without reset. Auto-scroll and normal CSS transitions are left enabled. Counts can be overridden and are recorded.
meaning.snapshots: Complete component DOM HTML and live control properties are retained at initial, warmup end and measurement end. Every stage is compared across processes without stripping component fields. Full document asset tags are excluded because bundles intentionally differ.
meaning.acceptance: All samples, failures, page errors and blocked requests are retained. No timing threshold is an acceptance criterion. This supplemental two-action workload does not replace the broader functional oracle or the 11-action benchmark.

boundary: Only MajorGC spans overlapping the first-to-last measured action window are included, including gaps between actions; startup, warmup and post-run calibration are excluded.
NVP stages attach only when pause duration and post-GC heap bytes uniquely match a main-thread trace MajorGC; ambiguous records remain null.
Before-byte definitions can differ slightly between the trace and NVP; raw fields remain available.
Stage counters can be nested/parallel and must not be summed as independent elapsed time.

Removing TestInstance descendant wrapping also changes lookup/allocation cost and GC scheduling. A reduction supports a harness contribution; it does not prove the WeakMap is the sole cause or establish browser behavior.

browserTrace.scope: Instrumented trace only; not combined with plain formal timing. Candidate has no parsed matching GC interval >=20ms; no statement that GC is absent.
Instrumented trace only; not combined with plain formal timing. Candidate has no parsed matching GC interval >=20ms; no statement that GC is absent.

limitations: The original 212.980/198.862ms actions were untraced; the 185.1338ms recurrence is directly attributed, not a retroactive breakdown of the old events.
Wrapper-free private-Fiber diagnostics alter lookup/allocation and GC scheduling and support a harness contribution; they do not establish a unique WeakMap or Intl-finalizer cause.
Formal event-to-layout timing uses flushSync and forced layout; 11 actions share a turn followed by two rAF callbacks. Not INP or physical display latency.
CDP TaskDuration includes in-page audit/snapshot/serialization work in its interval.
Paced mobile event-to-second-rAF medians increased about 0.2ms and p95 about 0.1ms; no outliers removed.
Natural instant-invalid-image outcomes differ; controlled-image parity does not erase this. Image behavior implementation was not changed.
Synthetic local inputs and local Chrome only; no production deployment, live merchant or remote image-network performance measurement.
